title: Bayesian Confidence Recalibration and Research-Equilibrium Criticality: Temporal Support in Robust Portfolios
abstract: arXiv:2609.03741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Robust portfolio rules that reconstruct confidence sets after learning need not preserve the evaluator obtained by prior-by-prior Bayesian transport. In the Gaussian model, this discrepancy is summarized by natural-coordinate displacement: inherited transport preserves it whereas fresh reconstruction can replace it. We price evaluator replacement and trace the resulting optimized curvature through endogenous research. Optimized robust value represents protocol regret as a functional Bregman divergence, while a within-vintage rectangular Gaussian benchmark with constant absolute risk aversion (CARA) yields a stopped recalibration tax. In a versioned model-release economy, validated history propagates through a strictly causal network and a same-cycle share of current optimized marginal value feeds back into research supply. translated_title: 贝叶斯置信度重校准与研究均衡临界性：稳健投资组合中的时间支撑
translated_abstract: 在学习之后重构置信集的稳健投资组合规则未必能保留通过逐先验贝叶斯传输所获得的评估器。在高斯模型中，这种差异由自然坐标位移来概括：继承的传输会保持其不变，而全新的重构则可以将其替换。我们对评估器的替换进行定价，并追踪由此产生的优化曲率如何通过内生研究进行传导。优化的稳健价值将协议遗憾表示为一种泛函Bregman散度，而在具有常数绝对风险厌恶（CARA）的同批次内矩形高斯基准下，则产生一个停止的重校准税。在一个带版本的模型发布经济中，经过验证的历史通过严格因果网络进行传播，并且当前优化边际价值的同周期份额会反馈到研究供给中。受容量约束的均衡最终归结为一个标量方程，其中包含按协议索引的增益……
tldr: 该论文指出学习后重构置信集会替换贝叶斯传输所得的评估器，将这种评估器替换定价为泛函Bregman散度形式的协议遗憾，并在带版本的模型发布经济中刻画了同周期价值反馈下的容量约束研究均衡。
en_tdlr: This paper prices the evaluator replacement caused by post-learning confidence-set reconstruction as a functional Bregman divergence representing protocol regret, and characterizes the capacity-constrained equilibrium in a versioned model-release economy where same-cycle optimized marginal value feeds back into research supply.
